# animalsounds

The goal of animalsounds is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of animalsounds from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Gonzalo1985/animalsounds")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(animalsounds)
animal_sounds("dog", "guau")
#> [1] "The dog says guau!"
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`animal_pet()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/animalsounds/reference/animal_pet.md)
  : Function that define which anumals are pet
- [`animal_sounds()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/animalsounds/reference/animal_sounds.md)
  : Function that takes animal and sound as input parameters
- [`farm_animals`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/animalsounds/reference/farm_animals.md)
  : Farm animal names, sounds and feed
